query:
-- Angel Food Cake
UPDATE projects 
SET 
  excerpt = 'A mobile home interior for the West Coast premiere of Angel Food Cake at Western Summer Theatre. Plaid upholstery, red-checkered backsplash, wood-paneled walls—everyday space holding extraordinary emotional weight. The home itself becomes a character.',
  seoKeywords = 'theatrical rendering, mobile home set design, Angel Food Cake, Western Summer Theatre, domestic interior, Vectorworks, Twinmotion, scenic visualization'
WHERE slug = 'angel-food-cake';

-- Isolation
UPDATE projects 
SET 
  excerpt = 'Set in a quiet, imagined interior, this rendering explores themes of isolation, distance, and the weight of solitude. A contemplative space where architecture becomes emotion, and emptiness speaks volumes.',
  seoKeywords = 'concept rendering, isolation theme, architectural visualization, contemplative space, interior design, theatrical rendering, pandemic art'
WHERE slug = 'isolation';

-- New Swan Venue File
UPDATE projects 
SET 
  excerpt = 'Complete Vectorworks venue file for the New Swan Theatre, documenting the outdoor performance space with technical precision. A digital archive of architectural detail and theatrical infrastructure.',
  seoKeywords = 'venue file, New Swan Theatre, Vectorworks, technical documentation, outdoor theatre, architectural drawing, performance space, CAD rendering'
WHERE slug = 'new-swan-venue-file';
